title: A Second Chance
subtitle: Because Some People Are Never Meant to Leave
quote: Some people leave your life to teach you their value. Some return to prove they were never meant to leave.
endQuote: Sometimes, second chances become the most beautiful chapters of our lives.

content.text: After days of silence, I had almost convinced myself that everything was over.
Every morning, I still looked at my phone hoping to see Grace's name.
Every night, I slept with unanswered questions.
The silence between us was louder than any argument we had ever had.
Then...
One ordinary day...
My phone vibrated.
It was her.
For a few seconds, I simply stared at the notification.
My hands trembled as I opened the message.
There were no dramatic words.
No long explanation.
Just a simple message.

content.speaker: Grace
content.text: Hari...
That single word was enough.
I smiled.
Not because the problem had disappeared.
But because she had chosen to come back.
We slowly started talking again.
At first, our conversations were careful.
Both of us were afraid of saying something that might hurt the other.
But day by day...
The distance between us disappeared.
This time, we understood each other better.
We listened more.
We argued less.
We learned that every relationship needs patience.
That misunderstanding didn't end our story.
It strengthened it.
After that day, our friendship became even more beautiful.
We no longer took each other's presence for granted.
Every conversation became more valuable.
Every laugh became more meaningful.
Sometimes, life breaks two people apart...
Only to bring them back together with a stronger bond.
And that's exactly what happened to us.
